detail.en: Build products and indexes. Xcode rebuilds them the next time you build.
detail.es: Productos de compilación e índices. Xcode los vuelve a crear la próxima vez que compiles.

title.es: Archivos de Xcode de más de 90 días

detail.en: Archived builds you uploaded or exported. They hold the dSYMs for crash reports from those versions, so this is unchecked by default.
detail.es: Compilaciones archivadas que subiste o exportaste. Guardan los dSYM para los informes de fallos de esas versiones, por eso no se marcan por defecto.

title.es: Archivos de soporte de dispositivos antiguos

detail.en: Symbols Xcode copies from each device and OS version you debug. The newest 2 of each platform are kept; Xcode copies older ones again if you connect such a device.
detail.es: Símbolos que Xcode copia de cada dispositivo y versión del sistema que depuras. Se conservan los 2 más recientes de cada plataforma; Xcode vuelve a copiar los antiguos si conectas un dispositivo así.

rules.note: keepNewest applies to each path entry separately, so each platform keeps its own newest 2 (by newest modification). visionOS used the xrOS name in early Xcode 15 betas.

detail.en: Simulator devices whose runtime is no longer installed. They can't be launched; Xcode's own command removes them.
detail.es: Dispositivos de simulador cuyo runtime ya no está instalado. No se pueden abrir; el propio comando de Xcode los elimina.

rules.note: Measured by sizing ~/Library/Developer/CoreSimulator/Devices/<udid> for each device listed by `xcrun simctl list devices unavailable -j`. Offered only when at least one device is unavailable.

detail.en: Cloned package repositories and downloaded binaries. Packages download again when a project resolves them.
detail.es: Repositorios de paquetes clonados y binarios descargados. Los paquetes se vuelven a descargar cuando un proyecto los resuelve.

detail.en: Packages npm keeps after installing. They download again on the next install.
detail.es: Paquetes que npm guarda después de instalar. Se vuelven a descargar en la siguiente instalación.

rules.note: Only the content cache. ~/.npm/_logs, _npx and config stay.

detail.en: Packages Yarn keeps after installing. They download again on the next install.
detail.es: Paquetes que Yarn guarda después de instalar. Se vuelven a descargar en la siguiente instalación.

detail.en: Runs pnpm store prune, which removes only packages no project uses.
detail.es: Ejecuta pnpm store prune, que elimina solo los paquetes que ningún proyecto usa.

rules.note: Never trashed directly: projects hard-link into the store. Measured by sizing the folder `pnpm store path` prints, so the saving shown is an upper bound. Corepack shims (e.g. ~/.local/bin/pnpm) are not used because they may download pnpm.

title.es: Descargas y versiones antiguas de Homebrew

detail.en: Runs brew cleanup, which removes cached downloads and outdated versions of installed formulae.
detail.es: Ejecuta brew cleanup, que elimina descargas en caché y versiones desactualizadas de las fórmulas instaladas.

rules.note: Measured by the size of ~/Library/Caches/Homebrew; old Cellar versions are not counted, so the real saving can be larger.

detail.en: Downloaded pods and spec repositories. pod install downloads them again.
detail.es: Pods descargados y repositorios de especificaciones. pod install los vuelve a descargar.

detail.en: Downloaded dependencies and build caches. Gradle downloads them again on the next build.
detail.es: Dependencias descargadas y cachés de compilación. Gradle las vuelve a descargar en la siguiente compilación.

rules.note: Only ~/.gradle/caches; the wrapper distributions, daemon and gradle.properties stay. Skipped while Android Studio runs because its Gradle daemon holds files open.

detail.en: Files apps keep to start or load faster. Apps rebuild them as needed. Caches of apps that are open are skipped.
detail.es: Archivos que las apps guardan para abrir o cargar más rápido. Las apps los vuelven a crear cuando los necesitan. Se omiten las cachés de las apps abiertas.

rules.note: Excluded, and why: browser caches have their own rules (Google, Chrome, Arc, Firefox, Mozilla, Edge, Brave, Safari, SafeBrowsing); developer rules own Homebrew, Yarn, CocoaPods, org.swift.swiftpm. Account, iCloud and sync state that is slow or risky to rebuild: CloudKit, com.apple.bird (iCloud Drive), com.apple.akd (Apple ID auth), com.apple.accountsd, com.apple.appleaccountd, com.apple.amsaccountsd, com.apple.AuthenticationServicesCore.* (passkeys), com.apple.iCloud*/icloud*, FamilyCircle, familycircled, com.apple.HomeKit, com.apple.homed, com.apple.findmy.*, com.apple.passd, PassKit (Wallet), com.apple.ap.adprivacyd. Owned by system daemons or in-flight work: com.apple.containermanagerd, com.apple.cache_delete (macOS purges these itself), com.apple.nsurlsessiond (background downloads in progress), com.apple.appstoreagent and com.apple.storekitagent and com.apple.commerce (App Store downloads and receipts), com.apple.FileProviderDaemon.*, com.apple.DeviceCheckInternal, com.apple.managedappdistributionagent (managed app installs). Sync and family state: com.apple.dataaccess.dataaccessd (Exchange/CalDAV/CardDAV account sync), askpermissiond and AskPermissionUI (pending Ask to Buy requests). Pointless: com.apple.nsservicescache.plist and other tiny top-level index files are rebuilt at once. Updates staged by Squirrel (*.ShipIt) could be half-installed. Playwright browsers (ms-playwright*, org.webkit.Playwright) are installs, not caches: nothing re-downloads them automatically. KeelMac's own cache (mx.cvillegas.keelmac*).

detail.en: Web pages and images Safari stored to load sites faster. History, bookmarks, passwords and cookies are not touched.
detail.es: Páginas e imágenes que Safari guardó para cargar sitios más rápido. No se tocan el historial, los marcadores, las contraseñas ni las cookies.

rules.note: ~/Library/Caches/com.apple.Safari is protected by macOS privacy controls; reading it needs Full Disk Access. ~/Library/Safari (history, bookmarks) is a PathGuard protected location.

detail.en: Chrome's web cache. Profiles, history, passwords and cookies live elsewhere and are not touched.
detail.es: La caché web de Chrome. Los perfiles, el historial, las contraseñas y las cookies están en otro lugar y no se tocan.

rules.note: Profiles are in ~/Library/Application Support/Google/Chrome, never matched here.

detail.en: Arc's web cache. Spaces, history, passwords and cookies are not touched.
detail.es: La caché web de Arc. No se tocan los espacios, el historial, las contraseñas ni las cookies.

detail.en: The web cache of each Firefox profile. Profiles, history, passwords and cookies are not touched.
detail.es: La caché web de cada perfil de Firefox. No se tocan los perfiles, el historial, las contraseñas ni las cookies.

rules.note: Only cache2 inside the cache profile folders; real profiles are in ~/Library/Application Support/Firefox.

detail.en: Microsoft Edge's web cache. Profiles, history, passwords and cookies are not touched.
detail.es: La caché web de Microsoft Edge. No se tocan los perfiles, el historial, las contraseñas ni las cookies.

detail.en: Brave's web cache. Profiles, history, passwords and cookies are not touched.
detail.es: La caché web de Brave. No se tocan los perfiles, el historial, las contraseñas ni las cookies.

title.es: Registros de apps de más de 7 días

detail.en: Log files apps wrote to your Library. A folder is listed only when nothing in it changed for 7 days.
detail.es: Archivos de registro que las apps escribieron en tu Biblioteca. Una carpeta aparece solo si nada en ella cambió en 7 días.

rules.note: DiagnosticReports has its own rule. Age uses the newest file inside each folder.

title.es: Informes de fallos de más de 7 días

detail.en: Reports macOS wrote when apps crashed or hung. Newer reports stay so you can still send them.
detail.es: Informes que macOS escribió cuando una app falló o se colgó. Los más recientes se quedan para que aún puedas enviarlos.

detail.en: Disk images and installer packages in your Downloads folder. Once an app is installed you rarely need them.
detail.es: Imágenes de disco y paquetes de instalación en tu carpeta Descargas. Una vez instalada la app, rara vez los necesitas.

rules.note: Top level of ~/Downloads only; subfolders are the user's own organisation.

title.es: Copias de seguridad de iPhone y iPad

detail.en: Local backups made by Finder. Check the device and date before removing one: a backup can't be recreated after the device changes.
detail.es: Copias locales hechas con Finder. Revisa el dispositivo y la fecha antes de quitar una: una copia no se puede volver a crear después de que el dispositivo cambie.

rules.note: Each backup folder is one item; device name, model, iOS version and date come from its Info.plist, encryption from Manifest.plist. MobileSync is protected by macOS privacy controls.

detail.en: Runs docker system prune, which removes stopped containers, unused networks, dangling images and build cache. Volumes and tagged images stay.
detail.es: Ejecuta docker system prune, que elimina contenedores detenidos, redes sin usar, imágenes huérfanas y la caché de compilación. Los volúmenes y las imágenes con etiqueta se quedan.

rules.note: Offered only when the Docker daemon responds (docker info exits 0). The size shown is the reclaimable space of containers and build cache from docker system df; dangling images are freed too but not counted.

title.es: Idiomas sin usar en apps sin firma

detail.en: Translations you don't use, in apps without a code signature. Signed apps are never changed: removing files from them breaks their signature and macOS would refuse to open them.
detail.es: Traducciones que no usas, en apps sin firma de código. Las apps firmadas nunca se modifican: quitarles archivos rompe su firma y macOS se negaría a abrirlas.

rules.note: Only ~/Applications. An app counts as unsigned when it has no Contents/_CodeSignature and `codesign -dv` fails. English, Spanish, Base and the user's preferred languages are kept. Usually finds nothing, which is the honest result.

detail.en: Items already in the Trash on this Mac and on connected disks. Emptying deletes them permanently.
detail.es: Elementos que ya están en la Papelera de esta Mac y de los discos conectados. Vaciarla los elimina de forma permanente.

rules.note: Deleted permanently (deletesPermanently), the only rule that does. ~/.Trash is protected by macOS privacy controls. Volume trashes are /Volumes/<name>/.Trashes/<uid>; the Macintosh HD link to / is a symlink and is never followed.
